audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabricated mechanics run through this page. (a) A 'percent-HP passive' in phases[4].why, whys[4], spikes[2].text and wants.foe[2] — Dauntless Instinct marks a target to take more damage on his next attack; there is no percent-health damage anywhere in his kit. (b) 'Q3 wall-knockup' in whys[2], wants.you[1], wants.foe[1], dosFull[1] and report[5] — Ntofo Strikes at 2 stacks fires a shockwave that PULLS enemies in; the wall knockback is All Out (R), an ultimate, not a Level 3 ability. (c) 'W-block' and 'W-heal' throughout — Path Maker is a charged dash that takes reduced damage while charging and stuns on release; it blocks nothing and heals nothing. The healing is on All Out.
audit.why: Each of these sends the player to the wrong position. Believing the knockup is on his Q makes her play away from walls at Level 3, when the wall danger is his ultimate at 6. Believing W is a block makes her hold her combo waiting for a block that never happens, instead of simply beating the 14s charge. And Path Maker deals true damage, so the page's implicit 'stack armour and survive it' reading is exactly backwards.
audit.corrected: Percent-HP replaced with the real All Out profile (heal, damage bonus, cut resistances, and Path Maker losing its stun while All Out) in whys[4], spikes[2].text, wants.foe[2] and enemyWin. The pull correctly attributed to two-stack Ntofo Strikes with its 3.5s cooldown and 450 range in whys[2] and wants.foe[1]; the wall launch moved to All Out in wants.you[1]. Path Maker's real behaviour, 14-to-10s cooldown and true damage written into dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t and report[7].t both attach the healing to W: 'cuts his passive-healing on W-block' and 'Ignite counters his W-heal'.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal against All Out (R). The Grievous Wounds timing therefore is not 'early' in the abstract — it is before he reaches 6, because that is the first moment there is any healing to cut. Aiming the anti-heal at a non-existent W heal means the player buys it for the wrong reason and may drop it at the wrong time.
audit.corrected: Both lines re-pointed at All Out, with the buy timed to before Level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page has no burst tell at all — it tells the player to watch for ability casts.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags autoreset-burst-tell on Dauntless Instinct: his abilities mark you and the damage arrives on the empowered attack that follows. The cue to step back is the attack wind-up after the ability, not the ability itself, and a player watching the wrong animation eats the marked hit every time.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] rewritten to the mark-then-empowered-auto pattern.
